short: The three sqlx-backed stores, each built from a caller-owned PgPool
is: The three sqlx-backed stores, each built from a caller-owned `PgPool`; cheap to clone, own no runtime.
conventions: SQL lives in `queries/<store>/<op>.sql`, not inline; migrations come from `build.rs`'s embedded set.
sqlx surface is `derive` only — never enable `macros`.
